sheet.title: MULTI-LANE TWO-WAY ROADWAY DOUBLE INTERIOR LANE CLOSURE
sheet.provenanceNote: Double interior short-term. Taper/AW/roll/PV == 311. Adds channelizing matrix. Dual-approach plan; primary walk MERGING TAPER. Roles: 01=PV,02=roll,03=taper,04=AW.

applicability.durationDefinition: Daytime work that occupies a location for more than 1 hour within a single daylight period (Note 1).

speedRangeMph.note: Table 311-02 has rows for 25/30/35/40/45/50/55 only. This sheet does NOT cover 60 or 65 mph. Reject or escalate a speed outside this range instead of extrapolating.

applicability.shoulderWidthBandNote: Table 311-02 has exactly three shoulder columns. Any shoulder width of 8 ft or more maps to the '>= 8 ft' band. Do not interpolate per-foot values between 8 and 12 ft — the sheet does not provide them.
applicability.areaTypeNote: Table 311-03 is keyed on URBAN vs RURAL and, for URBAN, on the preconstruction posted speed limit. Area type is a REQUIRED input for this sheet and is not derivable from speed alone.

allowed: WORKERS ON FOOT OR VEHICLE EXPOSED TO TRAFFIC

325-01.title: PROTECTIVE VEHICLE REQUIREMENTS

rows.exposureCondition: WORKERS ON FOOT OR VEHICLE EXPOSED TO TRAFFIC
WORKERS ON FOOT OR VEHICLE EXPOSED TO TRAFFIC

legend.P: PROTECTIVE VEHICLE REQUIRED FOR EACH CLOSED LANE & EACH CLOSED PAVED SHOULDER 8' OR WIDER, IF THE WORK SPACE MOVES WITHIN THE STATIONARY CLOSURE, THE PROTECTIVE VEHICLE SHALL BE REPOSITIONED ACCORDINGLY

tableNotes: 1. THE EXPOSURE CONDITIONS ASSUMES THERE IS NO POSITIVE PROTECTION PRESENT
2. EITHER A PROTECTIVE VEHICLE OR THE STANDARD BUFFER SPACE SHALL BE PROVIDED

325-02.title: ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE
325-02.columnMeaning: ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE (FT.)/# OF SKIP LINES FOR VEHICLES - STATIONARY OPERATION - MIN and MAX, for a 24000 LB PROTECTIVE VEHICLE WITH TMIA (see Table 311-01)
325-02.usageNote: This table gives a MIN and a MAX, not a single value. A plan must choose a value in the range and be able to justify it. Do not silently emit the max as if it were 'the' roll ahead distance.

325-03.title: LONGITUDINAL BUFFER SPACE AND TAPER LENGTHS

columnMeaning.longitudinalBufferSpace: LONGITUDINAL BUFFER SPACE DISTANCE (FT.)/ # OF SKIP LINES
columnMeaning.laneTaper: TAPER LENGTH: L (FT.)/ # OF SKIP LINES/ # OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES, FOR LANE WIDTH IN FT. (LATERAL SHIFT OF TRAFFIC FLOW PATH)
columnMeaning.shoulderTaper: SHOULDER TAPER LENGTH: L/3 (FT.)/ # OF SKIP LINES/ # OF CHANNELIZING DEVICES, FOR SHOULDER WIDTH

columnMeaning.XX: SIGN LEGEND substituted into the W20-1 sign: 'ROAD WORK XX'
columnMeaning.YY: SIGN LEGEND substituted into the W20-5R sign: 'RIGHT LANE CLOSED YY'

stationing.origin: Upstream edge of the WORK AREA
stationing.positiveDirection: Upstream, against the direction of travel
stationing.note: This matches the existing order-table walk (station 0 at path start, spacings accumulate upstream). Everything downstream of the WORK AREA is a separate downstream alignment with its own station 0 at the downstream edge of the WORK AREA.

crossSection.description: Multilane undivided roadway: two travel lanes each direction separated by a double yellow centerline, paved shoulder outside each outer travel lane.
crossSection.closedLane: The right (outer) travel lane in the direction of travel
crossSection.closedShoulder: The paved shoulder outboard of the closed lane
crossSection.lateralReference: Offsets are measured from the roadway centerline (double yellow) toward the closed side unless stated otherwise.

channelizingDeviceLine.description: Longitudinal cone line delineating the closed lane. Runs just outboard of the lane line between the two same-direction travel lanes.

minOpenAdjacentLaneWidthFt.note: Appears twice on the sheet: on the main plan and in Detail 311A. It is a MINIMUM clear width for the remaining open travel lane adjacent to the closure.

workAreaHatch.from: lane line between the two same-direction travel lanes
workAreaHatch.to: outer edge of the paved shoulder
workAreaHatch.note: The hatched WORK AREA spans the closed travel lane AND the closed paved shoulder (confirmed on the main plan and Detail 311A).

protectiveVehicle.placement: Within the closed travel lane, parallel to traffic, front wheels aligned with the lane striping (Note 3).

arrowPanel.placement: On the paved shoulder, outboard of the closed travel lane.

advanceWarningSigns.placement: Post-mounted on the right shoulder, outboard of the closed shoulder, clear of the channelizing devices.

corridor.description: Double interior lane closure — advance warning on both approaches. Primary upstream walk uses MERGING TAPER + buffer + roll (same skeleton as 311).

zones.note: Closest advance warning sign to the taper.

Verified from the PDF vector layer: the A dimension line (x=326.4, y 479.9-572.1) and the shoulder taper dimension line (x=133.6, y 479.9-509.2) share the datum y=479.9, so the shoulder taper lies INSIDE gap A. A does not stack on top of the shoulder taper length.

zones.lateralShift: From the outer edge of the paved shoulder inward to the outer edge of the closed travel lane
zones.note: L/3 per the Table 325-03 column header. It is the UPSTREAM continuation of the same cone line as the lane taper — the two tapers share the point at the travel-lane/shoulder edge and must be drawn continuous, with no lateral jog. It is an OVERLAY on gap A, not a sequential station: it starts where the lane taper ends and runs upstream inside A.

zones.lateralShift: From the outer edge of the closed travel lane inward to the longitudinal channelizing device line
zones.note: Sheet labels this MERGING TAPER (L), not LANE TAPER.

zones.lengthNote: Project-specific. The sheet does not set a work area length — it must come from the engineer/site. This is the ONLY length on this sheet that is not table-driven.
zones.note: Hatched box spanning the closed travel lane and the closed paved shoulder. Bounded upstream by the ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE and downstream by the DOWNSTREAM TAPER.

signs.note: Order and legend text are both sheet-driven. The XX/YY legend substitution from Table 325-04 is what disambiguates SignLibrary variants — do not resolve a distance-vs-AHEAD variant by guessing.

items.positionNote: Downstream of the work area, 80-400 ft past the end of the downstream taper.

items.signLibraryNote: This is a VEHICLE-MOUNTED sign, not a roadside post-mounted advance warning sign. On the plan it is a leader callout pointing at the protective vehicle. A missing SignLibrary post-mounted entry for NYW8-33 is therefore NOT a gap that blocks this sheet — do not place it on a post.

items.positionNote: Closest advance warning sign to the taper.
Furthest upstream of the three advance warning signs.
items.signLibraryNote: SignLibrary key = base + legend suffix. 'W20-01R' is the Work (ROAD) family — the R here means ROAD, not Right (contrast W20-05R where R means Right). Suffix from the Table 325-04 XX value: AHEAD -> A, a feet distance -> F, a mile distance -> M. URBAN >= 45 MPH gives 'ROAD WORK 1000 FT.' -> W20-01RF; URBAN <= 40 MPH gives 'ROAD WORK AHEAD' -> W20-01RA.

items.note: Sheet prints W20-5 without R/L suffix; right-closure default W20-05R + legend.
Two flags per sign, at the upper corners. Shown on W20-1 and W4-2R only; W20-5R and G20-2 have no flags on this sheet.

items.stationAnchorNote: At the junction of the LANE TAPER and the SHOULDER TAPER, i.e. the upstream end of the lane taper. NOT at the upstream end of the shoulder taper.

printed: 1. SHORT-TERM STATIONARY IS DAYTIME WORK THAT OCCUPIES A LOCATION FOR MORE THAN 1 HOUR WITHIN A SINGLE DAYLIGHT PERIOD.
2. IN URBAN CONDITIONS, ADVANCE WARNING SIGN SPACINGS MAY BE ADJUSTED IN ORDER TO ACCOMMODATE SIDE STREETS AND DRIVEWAYS. IF THERE IS A CONFLICT, MOVE THE SIGN UPSTREAM.
3. THERE SHALL BE NO WORKERS, EQUIPMENT OR OTHER VEHICLES IN THE BUFFER SPACE OR THE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE.
4. THE PROTECTIVE VEHICLE(S) SHALL MAINTAIN THE APPROPRIATE ROLL AHEAD DISTANCE, BE AN UNOCCUPIED TRUCK POSITIONED PARALLEL TO TRAFFIC.
5. CHANNELIZING DEVICE SPACING (CENTER TO CENTER) SHALL NOT EXCEED 40' IN THE ACTIVE WORK SPACE.

rules.assert: No work area hatch, protective vehicle, equipment or other symbol may overlap the bufferSpace or rollAheadDistance zones.
rules.commonFailure: Drawing the work area hatch from station 0 through the roll ahead distance.

rules.assert: The WORK AREA lies on the opposite side of station 0 from the upstream order-table walk. It must not occupy any upstream station.
rules.commonFailure: Using the Vehicle Space or Roll Ahead station as the work area extent.

rules.assert: Walking upstream from the shoulder taper, advance warning signs must appear in the order W4-2R, then W20-5R, then W20-1.
rules.commonFailure: Placing W20-1 nearest the taper and W4-2R furthest upstream (reversed).

rules.assert: Advance warning sign spacings A/B/C come from Table 311-03 keyed on areaType and preconstruction posted speed. They are equal to each other on this sheet.
rules.commonFailure: Using a fixed 350 ft default regardless of area type and speed.

rules.assert: W20-1 legend is 'ROAD WORK ' + XX and W20-5R legend is 'RIGHT LANE CLOSED ' + YY, with XX/YY read from Table 311-03.
rules.commonFailure: Choosing a SignLibrary distance variant by guessing instead of reading XX/YY.

rules.assert: The arrow panel sits at the upstream end of the LANE TAPER, on the shoulder — the same station where the shoulder taper begins.
rules.commonFailure: Anchoring it at the upstream end of the shoulder taper, one full shoulder-taper length too far upstream.

rules.assert: The shoulder taper and the lane taper form one continuous channelizing device line; they share the point at the travel-lane/shoulder edge with no lateral jog.
rules.commonFailure: Ending the shoulder taper at a fractional lane offset while the lane taper starts at zero offset.

rules.assert: The upstream station walk contains exactly: Roll Ahead Distance, Buffer Space, Lane Taper, then the three advance warning signs. No Vehicle Space, no temporary barrier, no box/corrugated beam row, and no Shoulder Taper row.
rules.commonFailure: Emitting the generic 7-row default upstream table for every sheet.

rules.assert: The shoulder taper starts where the lane taper ends and runs upstream INSIDE gap A. It consumes no station of its own; gap A is measured from the lane-taper/shoulder-taper junction to the first advance sign.
rules.commonFailure: Treating the shoulder taper as a sequential station row, which pushes every advance warning sign upstream by L/3.

rules.assert: G20-2 is placed on the downstream alignment, 80-400 ft past the end of the downstream taper.
rules.commonFailure: Placing G20-2 on the upstream alignment beyond the advance warning signs.

rules.assert: Roll ahead distance is a MIN/MAX range; the chosen value must be inside it and recorded.
rules.commonFailure: Treating one endpoint as the only value.

rules.assert: Preconstruction posted speed must be one of 25/30/35/40/45/50/55 for this sheet.
rules.commonFailure: Accepting 60 or 65 mph and extrapolating a taper length.

rules.assert: Shoulder widths of 8 ft and above all use the '>= 8 ft' column. No distinct 9/10/11/12 ft values exist.
rules.commonFailure: Inventing per-foot shoulder taper lengths above 8 ft.

rules.assert: Longitudinal channelizing device spacing must not exceed 40 ft.
rules.commonFailure: Drawing a bare polyline with no spacing annotation or device count.

rules.assert: At least 10'-0" of open travel lane must remain between the roadway centerline and the longitudinal channelizing device line.
rules.commonFailure: Offsetting the device line by a full lane width without checking the remaining open lane.

rules.assert: NYW8-33 'LANE CLOSED' is mounted on the protective vehicle, not on a roadside post.
rules.commonFailure: Reporting NYW8-33 as a blocking SignLibrary gap for post-mounted placement.

rules.assert: When a paved shoulder 8 ft or wider is closed for more than 800 ft, place transverse channelizing devices at least every 800 ft.
rules.commonFailure: Omitting Detail 311A entirely on long shoulder closures.

knownCodeDeviations.issue: Returns the same 7 upstream rows for every sheet, including Vehicle Space, Upstream Taper Temp Barrier and Upstream Taper Box/Corr Beam, none of which are on 619-311.
Defines distinct per-foot shoulder taper lengths for 8/9/10/11/12 ft. Table 311-02 has a single '>= 8 ft' column.
Computes 515/620/720/825/930/1030/1135/1365 by speed. These match no table on this sheet and the value is never consumed. Table 311-03 is 100/200/350/500 by area type.
